描述_EN: by the 9th century chinese kilns were producing a dense, white, glazed stoneware which we know as porcelain. the slightly flared sides and knopped stem are derived from similarly shaped vessels in silver. however, even prior to this, wares were produced that may have been less homogenous in body and glaze, but which can be considered antecedents to porcelain. this white stemcup, characterised by a thin body and bluish glaze, is a remarkable example. the ceramic industry rapidly developed in china during the tang dynasty (ad 618-960).
描述_ZN: 到了9世纪，中国的窑炉开始生产一种致密的、白色的、有釉的炻器，我们称之为瓷器。 略微外翻的侧面和有节的茎部来自于类似形状的银器。 然而，即使在这之前，所生产的器物在器身和釉面上可能不那么均匀，但可以被认为是瓷器的前身。 这个白色的茎杯，其特点是薄薄的器身和蓝色的釉，是一个显著的例子。 中国的陶瓷工业在唐代（公元618-960年）迅速发展。
